title: Memory and State Management
summary: This module provides various memory implementations for managing conversational history and state in AI applications, including simple buffers, summarization, vector store-backed memory, and entity tracking.

nodes.label: Conversational Memory
nodes.title: Manages Chat History
nodes.description: Provides various implementations for storing and managing conversation history, including simple buffers, sliding windows, summarization, and vector store-backed memory.

nodes.label: Entity Memory
nodes.title: Tracks Conversational Entities
nodes.description: Extracts, summarizes, and persists named entities from chat history, allowing the AI to maintain a deeper understanding of specific subjects and individuals over time.

nodes.label: Model Comparison & Evaluation
nodes.title: Compares LLM/Chain Performance
nodes.description: A utility for experimenting with and comparing different language models or chains, allowing users to observe and evaluate varied outputs for model selection and tuning.

edges.label: Provides raw history for
edges.title: Feeds raw history
edges.description: Conversational memory provides the raw message history that entity memory processes to extract and summarize entities.

edges.label: Can be used by models in
edges.title: Memory for tested models
edges.description: Models or chains being compared in the Model Laboratory can utilize conversational memory to maintain state during their execution.

edges.label: Can be evaluated by
edges.title: Evaluated by laboratory
edges.description: The effectiveness of entity memory in tracking and summarizing entities can be assessed and compared using the Model Laboratory.

groups.label: Core Memory Types
groups.title: Fundamental Memory Implementations
groups.description: This group includes the primary components for managing the flow and persistence of conversational history within AI applications.

groups.label: Advanced Memory Features
groups.title: Intelligent State Management
groups.description: Components focused on enhancing memory capabilities through entity extraction and summarization, providing richer context to AI models.

groups.label: Evaluation Tools
groups.title: Performance Assessment Utilities
groups.description: This component provides tools for comparing and evaluating the performance of different language models or chains, which can include those utilizing memory systems.
